requests.reply: {"translations": ["Seoyun, are you still at work?", "Yeah ㅠㅠ The meeting isn't ending. Jiwoo, have you left work?", "I just left. But did the contract go well?"]}
{"translations": ["Yeah, I stamped it yesterday. Now it's really over", "Heol, there are only three days left", "I know ㅠㅠ There's so much to do"]}

{"translations": ["Did you call a full-service moving company?", "No lol, semi-packaging. I'm moving on Saturday, but I have to pack the stuff myself", "What about the cat? It's going to be chaos on moving day"]}

{"translations": ["On Saturdays, I leave Bori at a pet hotel. They asked for an English name on the reservation form, so I wrote Barleyㅋㅋ", "ㅋㅋㅋㅋ Was Bori male or female? I always get confused", "She's female. She's three years old but still shy with strangers"]}

{"translations": ["Take some rest on Sunday after you finish moving. I want to see Bori too ㅋㅋ Do you want to grab brunch?", "Sounds good! Hyejin unnie said she's coming to help you organize on Sunday", "Oh, nice. Then Bori will be home that day too?"]}

{"translations": ["Yeah, Oppa said he'll drop me off on Sunday morning", "That's a relief. Should we call Subin too? ◆", "I asked, but Subin said she can't come on Sunday. She said she has a prior engagement"]}

{"translations": ["That's a shame. Oh, how should I write the new hire Chaeyul's English name? I need to send a calendar invite", "She said to write it as Chaeyul. Not 'Chaeyool' lol", "Okay. What are you going to do about the sofa? Bori used to sleep there every day"]}

{"translations": ["I posted it on Karrot and got a message right away. We decided to meet in person tomorrow evening.", "Oh, that was fast. Seoyun, you really cherished that sofa.", "I know ㅠㅠ but my new house is small, so I had no choice"]}

{"translations": ["Did you get the deposit for your old house? The landlady was quite strict, wasn't she?", "Not yet ㅠㅠ She told me to clean properly, so I have to wipe everything down before Sunday", "Heol, Sunday is a day off. Let's make Chaeyul do it ㅋㅋ"]}

{"translations": ["Right. They said they'll return the deposit as soon as the inspection is finished", "My brother used to work at a moving company. Should I ask him for some tips?", "Oh really? Does he still do it?"]}

{"translations": ["No, I quit last year and now I run a cafe. But I'll still give you some tips", "Thanks lol Jiwoo, did you send the Monday meeting invitation to Chaeyul too?", "Yeah, I just sent it. By the way, is Bori okay with riding in the car?"]}
{"translations": ["He runs away whenever he sees the carrier lol I should lure him with snacks"]}
